optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Program Manager, Identity Provider Service
professionalSummary: Experienced Technical Program Manager with a proven track record of running staged production rollouts of identity provider changes across multiple regions, conducting launch readiness reviews, coordinating with identity SRE teams, and documenting launch records with residual risks and hand‑over conditions.
experienceHighlights: Ran staged production rollouts of thirty‑four identity provider changes across five regions between 2022 and 2025, each on a rollout ticket in my name. (src_12b3239fe561)
Conducted launch readiness reviews before each rollout and maintained the rollout schedule for the identity service, with minutes and schedule stored in the identity launch folder. (src_5870d18b53be)

Monitored each rollout with identity SRE via the launch channel, halted four rollouts and rolled back one when sign‑in error rates moved outside the agreed band; events recorded on rollout tickets. (src_85d335009fd1)
Planned each change’s rollout stages and region order with engineering teams during rollout planning sessions, recording the plan on the rollout ticket before the readiness review. (src_eeac4f2eace9)
Authored launch records for each change, detailing residual risks, regions with flag‑based roll‑back, and hand‑over conditions for regional operations leads. (src_293ff69d232d)
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: rollout tickets for the last quarter, readiness review minutes for the same changes, and launch records for the four halted rollouts and the rollback. (src_caeb8df75506)

The evidence does not establish any additional responsibilities beyond those explicitly stated.

role.roleTitle: Technical Program Manager, Identity Provider Service

evidence.text: Ran the staged production rollouts of thirty-four identity provider changes across the five regions between 2022 and 2025, from the first canary region to full coverage, each on a rollout ticket in my name.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of staged rollouts across regions.

evidence.text: Ran the launch readiness review before each rollout and held the rollout schedule for the identity service, with the review minutes and the schedule in the identity launch folder.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of readiness review and schedule holding.

evidence.text: Watched each rollout with identity SRE from the launch channel and halted four rollouts and rolled back one when the sign-in error rate moved outside the agreed band; the five events are recorded on their rollout tickets.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of monitoring, halting, and rollback.

evidence.text: Planned each change's rollout stages and the region order with the engineering teams in the rollout planning session, recording the plan on the rollout ticket before the readiness review.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of planning with engineering teams.

evidence.text: Wrote the launch record for each change, listing the residual risks, the regions where the change stayed behind a flag and the hand-over conditions for the regional operations leads.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of launch record writing.
